4.9 Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Uttarakhand, Tremors Felt in Delhi-NCR

A magnitude 4.9 earthquake struck Uttarakhand on Tuesday night, around 10:20 PM. Tremors from the earthquake were felt across parts of Delhi and the National Capital Region (NCR).
